messages.subject: missing markers
parts:
Dear Dr. Karl Broman, Dear All

I am coming with one more question.

my goal is to create a genetic map from scratch using SNP markers

Because I have a reference genome I merely know  markers positions and I want just to recalculate the map.

I have already checked my data for genotyping errors  both by hand and with the rqtl program. 

in the import file in rqtl I have placed the missing SNP markers with the value "NA" 


- Is the presence of the value "NA" considered as recombination event in the est.map function?

- If yes, what could I type so as the missing markers not to considered as REC events?

Thank you in advance for your time

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] missing markers
parts:
No; missing genotypes are not assumed to be recombination events. 

karl
